about: One label per cluster of `scripts/build_hud_atlas.py harvest-weapons` (stride 1, seed 0, k 12) over a live sample of the RL agents' six games (scripts/sample_hud.py, 2026-10-03), labelled by eye from the contact sheet: a weapon key from hud/weapons.py WEAPONS, '?' for a reject template (scene showing through, no name), '-' to drop the cluster.
